intro_md: 📖 **6 min.** Nam gets home and meets another neighbour.

parts.title: Hope Street – Episode 3 (2/2): A Heavy Box
parts.md:
![Nam helps Mr Patel](data/img/w1/l4-patel.webp)

> When Nam got back to Hope Street, a man with a beard and a brown jacket was carrying a big box up the stairs.
>
> **Mr Patel:** Oh, you must be the new neighbour. I'm Raj Patel, Flat 3. Margaret has told me all about you.
>
> **Nam:** Of course she has.
>
> And they both laughed.
>
> **Mr Patel:** Could you give me a hand with this? It's a new TV, and it's heavier than it looks.
>
> Even though he was tired, Nam picked up the other end of the box. Two days in Manchester, and he already knew four people on Hope Street. That felt like a good start.

| Phrase | Meaning |
|---|---|
| *you **must be** the new neighbour* | I think you are the new neighbour (I'm almost sure) |
| *Margaret **has told me all about** you* | Margaret talked a lot about you (she talks about everyone! 😄) |
| *Of course she has.* | = of course she has told you – Nam is joking |
| ***give me a hand*** | help me |
| *heavier **than it looks*** | it looks light, but it's heavy |
| ***Even though** he was tired* | he was tired, **but** he still helped |
